questions.prompt: Which child is in grade four?
questions.explanation: Ben is the son in grade four.

questions.prompt: Why does Lily look at the drawing from close to the table?
options: To see it from her own height
To help the wind lift the cover
questions.explanation: She says the window is too high for her.

questions.prompt: What causes the drawing to fall into the tomatoes?
options: Wind lifts the cover and David reaches up to help
questions.explanation: While David helps hold the cover, his folder falls open and the drawing flies out.

questions.prompt: Why does David laugh instead of staying angry?
options: The paper is not damaged and he joins Lily’s laughter
He no longer needs the drawing
He has finished building the house
questions.explanation: He notices the tomato has not hurt the paper, takes a breath, and laughs too.
